import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf,sys
w=pd.read_parquet(sys.argv[1]+'/works.parquet')
w['y']=w['count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL']/w.n_passages
w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
print(w.year.isna().sum(), w.year.min(), w.year.max())
w=w.dropna(subset=['year'])
print(w.author_key.value_counts().describe())
w['aprod']=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count')
def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).y.mean().unstack()
    g=g.dropna(); return (g[1]-g[0]).mean(), g
e,g=est(w);print(e);print(g)
print(pd.crosstab(w.genre,w.late))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
for i in range(1000):
    d=w.groupby(['genre','late'],group_keys=False).apply(lambda x:x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)))
    bs.append(est(d)[0])
print('CI',np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for c in ['genre','origin','date_confidence']:
    print(pd.crosstab(w[c],w.late,normalize='columns').round(3))
print(w.groupby('late')[['n_editions','aprod']].mean())
print(w.groupby('date_confidence').apply(lambda x:est(x)[0]))
print(w.groupby('origin').apply(lambda x:est(x)[0]))
print(w.groupby('date_confidence').y.mean(), w.groupby('origin').y.mean())
m=smf.ols('y~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+np.log(n_editions)+np.log(aprod)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':w.author_key.astype('category').cat.codes})
print(m.summary().tables[1])
